acceptance.given: Evaluation runs Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages with separately owned mutable state.

oracle.expected: A state-isolation artifact records distinct state namespaces or handles for each component and demonstrates that mutating one component cannot alter another component's result.
forbidden: Any listed components share mutable state.
Cross-component mutation changes another component's result.
oracle.observable: The isolation test output and state-ownership manifest show unique ownership boundaries and a negative cross-contamination check.

acceptance.then: After the evaluation/rollback isolation validation completes.
acceptance.when: During evaluation execution, matrix processing, consumer handling, or rollback.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the state-isolation validator against a fixture that aliases mutable state between two named components; require deterministic rejection.

affected_subjects: Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages
slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce and report independent mutable-state ownership for Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages, including a cross-contamination negative check.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay and semantic-gate interfaces; rollback restores prior state-isolation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unisolated or unverifiable component state -> validated isolated mutable-state namespaces with contamination rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Isolation artifact proves every listed component has distinct mutable-state ownership and cross-component mutation cannot change another result.

acceptance.given: A non-empty Consumer Manifest and its applicable route transitions are loaded for evaluation.

oracle.expected: The manifest execution report contains every manifest entry and records completion of every applicable route transition for each entry, with no skipped or incomplete transition.
forbidden: Any manifest entry lacks a completed applicable transition.
A transition is skipped or left incomplete.
oracle.observable: A deterministic manifest-transition matrix reconciles all entries against all applicable transitions and shows 100% completion.

acceptance.then: After manifest route-transition evaluation and rollback baseline observation complete.
acceptance.when: When a non-empty Consumer Manifest is processed and route transitions are applicable.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the manifest-transition validator with one applicable transition intentionally omitted; require a red result identifying the missing transition.

affected_subjects: Non-empty Consumer Manifest entries and their applicable route transitions
slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate bidirectional manifest-entry/route-transition completion and emit a 100% completion report tied to rollback Prior Behavior Baseline evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep Consumer Manifest and route-state schemas backward compatible; rollback preserves prior baseline semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: Non-empty manifest with unverified transitions -> all applicable transitions completed and baseline-observed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Transition matrix reports every manifest entry completed for every applicable route transition and records the Prior Behavior Baseline after rollback.

acceptance.given: An invalid-package case is supplied to the Toolchain evaluation validator.

oracle.expected: Evaluation returns a rejection verdict for the invalid-package case and records the invalid-package reason.
forbidden: The invalid-package case is reported as success.
A success verdict is emitted without invalid-package diagnostics.
oracle.observable: The validator result JSON contains rejected status and invalid-package classification for the selected case.

acceptance.then: After the invalid-package evaluation command exits.
acceptance.when: When an invalid-package case is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the evaluator against an intentionally accepted invalid package; require a red assertion because success must be rejected.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Classify invalid-package inputs before success evaluation and force a rejection verdict with explicit diagnostics.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve evaluator result schema and existing valid-package behavior; rollback removes only invalid-package classification changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: Invalid package presented -> deterministic rejected verdict with reason.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Selected invalid-package case has status rejected and never success.

acceptance.given: The active Atomic Obligation set and runtime-evidence links are available to the exact-cover validator.

oracle.expected: Validation reports a complete bidirectional Exact Cover: every Atomic Obligation maps to exactly its required runtime evidence and every runtime-evidence node maps back to exactly one covered obligation, with no orphan evidence.
forbidden: Any Atomic Obligation lacks runtime-evidence coverage.
Coverage exists only in one direction.
oracle.observable: The exact-cover result artifact contains equal forward and reverse relation sets, zero orphan nodes, and per-obligation reciprocal matches.

acceptance.then: After exact-cover validation over obligations and runtime evidence.
acceptance.when: Whenever Atomic Obligation coverage is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Invoke exact-cover validation with one missing reverse runtime-evidence link and one orphan runtime-evidence node; require deterministic failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add exact reciprocal runtime-evidence relation checks to Atomic Obligation coverage validation, including orphan detection.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve VDD conformance CLI and result schema; rollback restores prior relation evaluation without altering stored obligations.

slice_hint.state_transition: Runtime-evidence links unverified -> forward/reverse exact-cover relation validated with zero orphans.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exact-cover artifact proves reciprocal one-to-one coverage for every Atomic Obligation/runtime-evidence pair and reports no orphan runtime evidence.
